analysis.nfr1: Reliability/Resilience: The Kitchen Display System must be fault-tolerant, capable of caching data and functioning without crashing for a minimum of 10 minutes during active network outages, seamlessly syncing data once restored.
analysis.nfr2: Performance: Critical inventory status updates (such as marking an item "Sold Out") must propagate from the kitchen interface to the mobile application in near real-time (e.g., under 2 seconds) under normal network conditions.
analysis.nfr3: Accessibility/Usability: The mobile application must provide a strict, user-configurable allergen filtering engine that dynamically and completely removes non-compliant items from the user interface, rather than merely disabling them.
